title: TracerPlay runbook - practical summaries (week of 2026-11-24)
content:
TL;DR: This week we ran a small trace-sampling experiment (p95 tail reduction vs cost) and iterated on a compact dashboard layout to make span-cost hotspots visible. Early signal: 18% reduction in retrieval pipeline tail with 10% fewer spans captured from low-value endpoints. Next week we validate across two more regions and harden alerting for sample-rate regressions.

Monday standup (notes):
- Aisha: kicked off A/B sampling on prod-1, traffic mirrored - saw initial p95 drop on retrieval-worker by ~12%.
- Marcus: dashboard proto (compact view) pushed to staging, working on widget for span cost per-tenant.
- Diego: debugged exporter memory bump; reverted transient change in agent v0.9.3.

Tuesday follow-ups:
- Confirmed sampling config applied via config-service (OBS-1024). Small bug: default fallback rate wasn't overridden for legacy clients — Diego will patch.
- Dashboard: added heatmap for top 10 spans by aggregate cost; Ellen suggested adding a per-route filter.

Wednesday sync (15m):
- Decision: keep sampling at 0.9 for user-facing read endpoints, 0.5 for internal batch jobs for next 72h. Rationale: preserve high-fidelity for latency-sensitive paths.
- Action: Marcus -> add a toggle in dashboard to compare 'sampled vs unsampled' latency histograms (due EOD Fri).

Thursday ops incident (minor):
- Spike in billing metrics after a config roll; root cause: double-instrumentation in v0.9.2. Mitigation: hotfix reverted, alert threshold tightened.
- Action: Ellen -> write quick postmortem outline and list preventative checks (due Mon).

Friday retro & next actions:
- Wins: compact dashboard reduced onboarding time for CS triage; sampling experiment gave tangible p95 improvement for retrieval.
- Risks: sampling must not hide regressions in new model variants; need durable gating for rollout.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Diego: patch fallback sampling behavior and ship agent v0.9.4 (ETA 2026-11-29).
- Marcus: deliver sampled vs unsampled histogram toggle + example queries (ETA 2026-11-27).
- Ellen: postmortem draft for double-instrumentation incident (ETA 2026-11-30).
- Aisha: run region validation for sampling config in eu-west and ap-south (start 2026-11-30, duration 3 days).

Open questions / decisions pending:
- How aggressively do we prune traces older than 7 days in the aggregated billing view? Need input from finance on acceptable telemetry loss vs cost.
- Should we add tenant-level quota alerts when a tenant's sampled span volume increases >50% week-over-week? (proposal in OBS-1031).

Notes for follow-ups:
- Link dashboards: /dashboards/trace-span-cost-compact (staging) and /dashboards/trace-sampling-a-b (experiment).
- Keep an eye on model-rollout jobs starting next Wednesday — sampling config must auto-backoff if latency regresses >10% p95 for 15m.

Random quick wins backlog (short):
- Small UX: expose span name truncation threshold as a user-settable param.
- Query perf: pre-aggregate span-cost by 1m buckets to speed the top-N widget.

Summary sentiment: cautious optimism. The sampling experiment is promising but we need safer guardrails before a broader rollout. This doc is the working runbook for the next two weeks — will update with validation results and the postmortem link.
